summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K disclosing receipt of an executed waiver from a holder of its Series A Convertible Preferred Stock. A closing of any shares of Series A Preferred Stock outstanding on or after September 30, 2026 would have triggered a default, raising the dividend to 18% per annum and permitting a Triggering Event Conversion at a 125% multiplier (25% premium). The holder waived these consequences from September 30, 2026 through January 31, 2027. Other preferred holders may deliver similar waivers. Watch for potential dilution if the waiver period lapses without a permanent cure.
